newsitem.title: USA: J. Baker August same-store sales rose.
newsitem.headline: J. Baker August same-store sales rose.

text.p: J. Baker Inc said Thursday that for the month ended August 31, comparable store sales increased 4.6 percent as compared with a year earlier.
The company said that sales for the four weeks ended August 31 decreased 13.2 percent to $66 million, compared with the $76 million reported for the four weeks a year before.
Year-to-date sales for the seven months ended August 31 were $493 million, compared with the $579 million reported for the year-earlier period.
